notes.title: TopSpin Patch 6.0
notes.notes:
Get ready for some exciting updates! A patch is scheduled for release today, February 17th, bringing new content to TopSpin!

Patch Highlights:
[olist]
 Added Season 6 Center Court Pass and Pro Shop content
 Updated serve animations for Keys, Agassi, and Sampras
 Added 3 new Tennis Styles and 10 new Pro Outfits to the Pro Shop
 Added "Net Points Won" to the Statistics screen in the Pause Menu
 Updated the logic for entering the Player Selection screen in Exhibition and 2K Tour modes to randomly select default Pro Outfits
 General bug fixes and improvements
[/olist]

This patch is scheduled for release today, February 17th, at 1 PM GMT / 2 PM CET / 5 AM PST!

The excitement continues with the launch of Season 6 shortly after, on February 18th at 6 AM GMT / 7 AM CET / 10 PM PST (Due to time zones, this will be February 17th PST).

For the best possible experience, we strongly encourage everyone to update to Patch 6.0 as soon as it's available.

See you on the court!

notes.title: TopSpin 2K25 Stability Patch
notes.notes: This update fixes a rare issue where certain users would not be able to load into Online modes or MyCAREER Laver Cup.

notes.title: TopSpin 2K25 Season 5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
What’s New:

 Added statistics between points to show various stats such as winners, unforced errors, aces, longest rally (and more) during matches
 Updated swing animations for Carlos Alcaraz (forehand, backhand) and Taylor Fritz (backhand)
 Added ability for AI-controlled pro players in MyCAREER to use alternate outfits in tournaments
 Added new World Tour League rewards exclusive to Season 5
 Added new G.O.A.T. objectives and rewards exclusive to Season 5
 Added new Tennis Styles and Pro Outfits in the Pro Shop

Gameplay Balancing Update:

 Updated the speed of the Timing Meter to make shots performed with a low Rally Energy meter and during long rallies harder to time perfectly
 Increased the chance of errors on Flat Power shots performed with a low Rally Energy meter and during long rallies when the timing isn't perfect
 Slightly increased the chance of errors on all other groundstrokes performed with a low Rally Energy meter and during long rallies when the timing isn't perfect
 Updated logic to make the Rally Energy meter deplete faster when using Flat Power shots repeatedly during a rally
 Made Slice Power shots consume less Rally Energy
 Updated the speed of the Timing Meter to make volleys a little easier to time perfectly, especially with a high Volley attribute or when the incoming ball is slow
 Updated the Focus Service, Advanced Serve Berserker, Diesel Server and Spin Serve Master skills to make them more noticeable
 Updated attributes for Carlos Alcaraz, Roger Federer and Andy Murray

Gameplay Stability Update:

 Game stability and server improvements
